text: The purpose of this report is to provide the annual summary of the City's employer contributions submitted to the Ontario Municipal Employees’ Retirement System (OMERS) in 2024 and to provide information on the City's members and contributions relative to the overall Ontario Municipal Employees’ Retirement System plan.
The General Government Committee: 1. Received the report (May 21, 2025) from the Executive Director, Finance Shared Services, for information.
